item.title: Squeak 2.33.0
item.description:
Ducks own their branch, and pond tiles that say what's happening.

  • Ducks mode: ducks sit under their pond with their branch, the header shows the duck's branch and Create PR for it, and "main · read-only" in the pond's own folder. Branch off, Work with… and Move to main are in a duck's menu.
  • The pond dashboard counts On duty, Working, Needs you and Off duty (with the total). Shared is a filter beside the search.
  • The sidebar shows each pond's on-duty ducks.
  • Leaving a pond never leaves you on an empty pond page, and Back no longer leads to a pond you left.
  • A pond's Room no longer opens blank after leaving it mid-slide.
  • Pond tiles are all one height.

Also in 2.32.0

Steadier windows, remote ponds made clear. Where you are is one thing now, so nothing resets as you move around.

  • A pond stays highlighted wherever you are in it: a chat, its home page or a new chat.
  • Clicking a pond takes you back to the chat you last had open there; the pond's name in the header opens its home page.
  • Each chat keeps its scroll position, and unsent text in pond threads, rooms and queued edits survives moving away.
  • Settings, pond pages and New chat open over the chat instead of replacing it, and Back/Forward includes them, Usage too.
  • Starting a new chat keeps the tabs in place with a "New chat" tab, which becomes the real chat as soon as you send.
  • "Next update" shows once, not twice. The jump-to-newest button and the @-mention picker no longer overlap anything.
  • Each workspace remembers its inspector tab and its open duckling, file and thread panels.
  • Fixed a crash when opening a chat in a pond someone shared with you.
  • In a pond someone shared with you, Squeak shows no code: no changes, files, terminals, branch or Create PR. It's marked Remote, and the composer says the chat runs on the owner's Mac.
  • Leave a pond someone shared with you from its menu in the sidebar or on its page.
  • Lighter: working glyphs share one 15 fps clock that pauses when the window is hidden, hidden chats stop polling, and the sidebar and tabs redraw far less.

Also in 2.31.0

Smoother everywhere. Full screen no longer stutters: Squeak now uses macOS's standard title bar instead of its own.

  • Full screen is as smooth as a normal window. The window buttons come from macOS, and in full screen they slide down with the menu bar.
  • No dim layer is left over a pond page after switching between Dashboard and Room, and no scroll bar rides along in the slide.
  • The Room opens at its newest message, already laid out: no blank page and no old messages popping in at the top.
  • Chats scroll more smoothly: formatted text is built once and reused, and reopening a recent chat reuses its rows.
  • Fewer jumps in chats: tables lay out once, "Show more" animates, and text is measured at its real width.
  • Removed animations that kept running in the background and slowed the whole window (the swipe hint's ripple, the loading pulse).
  • The ponds list keeps trying until it loads, and says "Loading ponds…" instead of "No ponds yet" while it does.
  • Invite goes straight to the invite form when this Mac is already signed in, and the sign-in sheet never sits blank.
